nodes.one_zh: z ≥ 3.0 或词覆盖够才进候选
nodes.one_en: Enter only at z ≥ 3.0 or solid coverage
nodes.def_zh: 候选池的唯一硬规则：z ≥ 3.0（z_gate）；词覆盖率 ≥ 0.5 的文件也进。3.0 由 v2.1 校准 A/B 定下（n=146 真模型评测）：从 2.0 提到 3.0，s@5 0.747→0.781、MRR 0.646→0.665、零命中诚实度 0.4→0.6，train 与 holdout 一致、零单题回归。扫描中 3.5 更好（0.822）但故意不采纳——一次扫描、过拟合风险，记录在案（「不做质量重试」纪律的来源）。
nodes.def_en: The one hard rule into the candidate pool: z ≥ 3.0 (z_gate); files with word coverage ≥ 0.5 also enter. The 3.0 came from a v2.1 calibration A/B (n=146, real-model eval): raising 2.0→3.0 moved s@5 0.747→0.781, MRR 0.646→0.665, zero-hit honesty 0.4→0.6, consistent across train and holdout with zero per-query regressions. Scanning found 3.5 even better (0.822) — deliberately not adopted: one scan, overfitting risk, on the record. This is where the 'no quality retries' discipline comes from.
nodes.plain_zh: 海选。不是所有自称「有点像」的文件都能进下一轮：要么语义上真的鹤立鸡群，要么查询词真的出现在它身上。门槛是拿 146 道真题做 A/B 试验定下来的，不是拍脑袋。曾看到 3.5 更好看，但只试了一次不敢信，忍住没改。
nodes.plain_en: Auditions. Not every file claiming 'kind of similar' gets to the next round: either it stands clearly above the crowd semantically, or the query words actually appear in it. The bar was set by an A/B test on 146 real questions, not by gut. A higher bar of 3.5 looked better once — one try, not trusted, left alone.
nodes.example_zh: A/B 记录：z_gate 2.0→3.0 使 s@5 0.747→0.781、MRR 0.646→0.665、zero-hit honesty 0.4→0.6；3.5 得 0.822 但弃用。对照回归门：python3 scripts/eval_real.py --suite legacy --backend llama --gate 应见 gate: green。
nodes.example_en: The A/B record: z_gate 2.0→3.0 moved s@5 0.747→0.781, MRR 0.646→0.665, zero-hit honesty 0.4→0.6; 3.5 scored 0.822 but was rejected. Check the regression gate yourself: python3 scripts/eval_real.py --suite legacy --backend llama --gate should print 'gate: green'.

nodes.one_en: High z alone cannot enter without word evidence
nodes.def_zh: search.v7 规则：混合模式查询下，一个文件若 z 分够高但没有任何词法证据（无 BM25 排名、coverage 为 0），不准进候选池。防的是语义模型的「空吸」——embedding 对某些查询天然亲近某些内容。例外：纯媒体文件（只有图片/音频向量、没有文字可沾）豁免——它们没资格提供见证，不能因此被判死刑。新增媒体段型时 _files_with_text 的口径要跟着审。
nodes.def_en: The search.v7 rule: under a hybrid-mode query, a file with a high z but zero lexical evidence (no BM25 rank, coverage 0) may not enter the pool. It guards against semantic 'vacuum suction' — embeddings are naturally chummy between certain queries and certain content. Exception: pure media files (only image/audio vectors, no text to match) are exempt — they cannot bear witnesses, so they cannot be condemned for lacking one. When a new media segment type appears, _files_with_text's definition must be re-audited.
nodes.plain_zh: 一个嫌疑人 DNA 匹配 99%，但案发现场、时间线、证人一样都对不上——光 DNA 一条孤证不放人。除非这个案子根本没有别的证据可查（比如纯图片文件，没文字可沾），那才破例。
nodes.plain_en: A suspect's DNA matches 99%, but crime scene, timeline, and witnesses all disagree — one lonely piece of evidence doesn't convict. Unless the case has no other evidence to check at all (a pure image file with no text to touch) — then, and only then, the exception applies.
nodes.example_zh: z=4.5、coverage=0、无 BM25 排名的文本文件 → 拒。同一文件若是纯图片（无文本段）→ 豁免放行。这是第一讲十问第 4 题的原题。
nodes.example_en: A text file with z=4.5, coverage 0, no BM25 rank → refused. The same file if it were a pure image (no text segments) → exempt, admitted. This is question 4 of the search walkthrough's ten-question self-check.

nodes.one_zh: 每个命中给你看哪一段
nodes.one_en: Which passage each hit shows you
nodes.def_zh: 每个命中的文件内部再选一次证据段：z 够高时主证据 = 语义最佳段，否则 = 关键词命中段；精确短语命中强制做主证据。evidence-window 规则：某段里 200 字符窗口内聚着的查询词比语义最佳段多 ≥2 个不同词时，主证据让位——语义模型偶尔被标题党吸走，词证密集处更可信。supporting 段随行，之后近重复折叠（同文件近似段只展一条）、«» 高亮、渲染输出。
nodes.def_en: Inside every hit, one more selection pass picks the evidence passage: with a high z the primary evidence is the semantically best segment, otherwise the keyword-hit segment; exact phrase hits force themselves primary. The evidence-window rule: when some segment concentrates ≥2 more distinct query words inside a 200-character window than the semantic best, it takes over — embeddings occasionally fall for clickbait titles, dense word evidence is more trustworthy. A supporting segment rides along; then near-duplicate folding (one display per near-identical group), «» highlighting, and rendering.
nodes.plain_zh: 找到一本书只是第一步，还得翻到最该给你看的那一页。通常翻到「意思最像」的那页；但如果有一页上你问的词密密麻麻挤在一起，就翻那一页——满页都是你问的词，比「感觉像」更实在。
nodes.plain_en: Finding the book is step one; you must still open the right page. Usually the page that 'means most like the query'; but if some page has your words crowded together, open that one — a page dense with your words beats a page that merely 'feels right'.
nodes.example_zh: goldmine search 加 --why 可见每个命中的 primary/supporting 段选择；标题党场景：标题含全部查询词但正文无关 → 词证密集窗口接管主证据。
nodes.example_en: Run goldmine search with --why to see each hit's primary/supporting selection; the clickbait case: a title carrying all query words over an unrelated body → the dense word window takes the primary slot.

nodes.one_zh: 答案材料包按 token 限额装
nodes.one_en: Answer packs sized by a token budget
nodes.def_zh: search --pack 把命中装成「答案材料包」：平铺记录（# 头块 + [n] 逐字记录 + # sources 尾块），整个 stdout 的 token 数用 backend.count_tokens 实测（估算器兜底，模式打印在头部）。装包顺序：整条主证据按排名序，再 supporting 段，再邻居上下文；装不下的整条跳过、后面候选递补；正文与引用永不截断。默认预算 4000 token，区间 [512, 32768]，至多 24 条记录；尾部 used N 是「渲染-测量不动点」，不收敛就丢最后一条重试——绝不打印一个没测过的数。
nodes.def_en: search --pack assembles hits into an answer-material pack: flat records (# header, [n] verbatim records, # sources footer), with the WHOLE stdout token-counted via backend.count_tokens (estimator fallback, mode printed in the header). Fill order: whole primary seeds in rank order, then supporting segments, then neighbor context; a nonfitting whole part is skipped and later candidates may fit; body text and citations are never truncated. Default budget 4000 tokens, range [512, 32768], at most 24 records; the footer 'used N' is a render-measure fixpoint — on non-convergence the last record drops and it retries, never printing an unmeasured number.
nodes.plain_zh: 给 AI 助手的资料袋有大小限额。装袋规矩：最重要的整篇先装，装不下的整篇不装（不许撕半页），装不下就换下一篇试试；袋口写着「实际用了多少」——这个数是量出来的，不是估出来的。
nodes.plain_en: The dossier you hand an AI has a size cap. Packing rules: most important whole items first; a whole item that doesn't fit is skipped, never torn in half; later items may still fit; the label on the bag states how much was actually used — measured, not guessed.
nodes.example_zh: python3 -m goldmine search '环氧垫片' --pack --budget 4000 --db evals/eval.sqlite；--budget 必须跟 --pack 一起用（--context 半径钳到 ≤3）。头块打印 token 模式（tokenize 或 estimate），尾块打印 used N 与 sources。
nodes.example_en: python3 -m goldmine search 'copper gasket' --pack --budget 4000 --db evals/eval.sqlite; --budget requires --pack (--context clamps to ≤3). The header prints the token mode (tokenize or estimate); the footer prints used N and sources.

nodes.one_zh: 旁边挂一个 C 写的媒体嵌入助手
nodes.one_en: A C helper child process for media embeddings
nodes.def_zh: llama-server 的 HTTP 接口不暴露 mtmd（多模态）嵌入——图片/音频进不了它。于是自写 1412 行纯 C11 的 goldmine-embed，静态链接 llama.cpp + mtmd 七个静态库，作为常驻边车与主程序同生共死。协议简单到不会错：每行一个 JSON（请求带 path_b64/wav_b64，回一个 768 维向量）。模型加载要搬约 1GB 进内存，常驻省的是加载与逐次 spawn，不是缓存计算图——gemma-embedding2 没有 KV 记忆，批次间只能清空重来。清理纪律：close() 按 pid 只杀自己 spawn 的子进程。
nodes.def_en: llama-server's HTTP surface does not expose mtmd (multimodal) embeddings — images and audio can't get in. So the project wrote goldmine-embed, 1412 lines of pure C11 statically linking llama.cpp + mtmd (seven static libs), as a resident sidecar living and dying with the parent. The protocol is too simple to get wrong: one JSON per line (request carries path_b64/wav_b64, response is one 768-dim vector). Model loading moves ~1GB into memory, so residency saves the load and the per-call spawn — not a cached compute graph: gemma-embedding2 has no KV memory and batches restart clean. Cleanup discipline: close() kills only children it spawned itself, by pid.
nodes.plain_zh: 主程序旁边挂一辆挎斗摩托：主车管文字，挎斗管图片和声音。挎斗一次造好、随叫随到，不用每送一单重新发动。俩车说话的规矩简单到极点——一次递一张纸条，纸条上只写一行字。
nodes.plain_en: A sidecar motorcycle hitched to the main bike: the bike handles text, the sidecar handles images and sound. Built once, on call always — no restarting the engine for every delivery. Their communication is as simple as it gets: pass one note at a time, one line per note.
nodes.example_zh: 启动握手：--version 探活 + mmproj sha 校验；健康失败 → NotSupported/BackendStartupError（exit 2）。源码 1412 行在 tools/embed/goldmine-embed.c。杀别人的 llama-server 是上古事故，pid 记账只杀自己的。
nodes.example_en: Startup handshake: a --version probe plus mmproj sha verification; health failure → NotSupported/BackendStartupError (exit 2). The 1412-line source is tools/embed/goldmine-embed.c. Killing someone else's llama-server is an ancient accident — the pid ledger kills only its own.

nodes.def_zh: 图片进模型不是无脑塞满：照片 140 token、截图 280、PDF 页 280、视频帧 70（合法集 70–1120）。预算决定图片进模型前的缩放尺寸，是成本与信息量的权衡（DigUp 实测先验）。预算写进指纹的 media_budgets 键——动预算 = 全量重嵌，不许悄悄动。
nodes.def_en: Images aren't shoved into the model at full blast: photos get 140 tokens, screenshots 280, PDF pages 280, video frames 70 (legal range 70–1120). The budget fixes the pre-model resize — a cost-versus-information tradeoff (DigUp's measured prior). Budgets live in the fingerprint's media_budgets key: changing a budget means re-embedding everything, so it may never move quietly.

nodes.plain_en: Photos deserve a magnifying glass; a form page needs one glance — different objects, different effort. The effort price list is published in black and white: change the list and you owe the world a re-look at every old photo.

nodes.one_zh: 一切决定向量取值的东西打包成哈希
nodes.one_en: Everything that decides vector values, hashed
nodes.def_zh: 一切「决定向量取值」的东西——模型身份、维度、提示词、池化、归一化、媒体加工串、预算——打包成 JSON，canonical 化后取 sha256 前 16 位。任何一项变 → 指纹变 → 旧库被门拒绝 exit 3。动机：两种指纹的向量混在一个库里互比分数 = 搜索静默变坏且无从察觉。它是四层身份模型（指纹 / embed_id 管哪些行重嵌 / 提取器注册表管哪些行重抽 / 评测基线管分母没被偷换）的第一层执法点。词法检索不过这道门，--lexical 永远可用；llama.cpp 构建串也刻意不进指纹——「向量没变」由参考向量测试证明，动了才升指纹字段。
nodes.def_en: Everything that decides vector values — model identity, dimension, prompts, pooling, normalization, media preprocessing strings, budgets — is packed into JSON, canonicalized, and sha256-hashed to 16 hex chars. Any change flips the fingerprint and the gate refuses the old library with exit 3. Rationale: vectors from two fingerprints compared in one library silently corrupt search with no way to notice. It is the enforcement point of layer 1 in the four-layer identity model (fingerprint / embed_id deciding which rows re-embed / extractor registry deciding which rows re-extract / eval baseline guarding the denominator). Lexical search skips this gate — --lexical is always available; the llama.cpp build string is deliberately excluded too — 'vectors unchanged' is proven by the reference-vector tests, and only a real change bumps fingerprint fields.
nodes.plain_zh: 菜品的配方指纹：原料、火候、厨具全部记下来盖个章。换任何一样，章就变了，老批次必须全部下架——新做法的菜和老批次摆在一起比味道，比试已经不公平了。另有一本分层的账：大门管「这个库还能不能用」，车间账本管「哪排货要返工」，别混成一团。
nodes.plain_en: A dish's recipe seal: ingredients, heat, cookware — all recorded and stamped. Change anything and the stamp changes; the old batch comes off the shelf. Comparing new-method dishes against old-batch dishes is a rigged taste test. There is also a layered ledger: the front gate decides 'can this library still be used'; workshop ledgers decide 'which shelf reworks' — never confuse the two.

nodes.one_zh: 一个文件一个事务，崩溃不残半
nodes.one_en: One transaction per file, never half
nodes.def_zh: 摄取的最小提交单位是「一个文件」：该文件的段、FTS 行、向量行在同一个事务里原子替换（旧段先删净、新段整体落库）。崩溃或 Ctrl-C（exit 130）最坏丢掉正在写的这一个文件的这一次，绝不留半个文件的段在库里。重跑靠内容哈希跳过未变文件，几乎零成本续传。配合 WAL，读写互不阻塞：扫描进行中也能随时搜索。
nodes.def_en: The smallest commit unit in ingest is one file: its segments, FTS rows, and vector rows are atomically replaced inside a single transaction (old segments fully deleted, new ones written whole). A crash or Ctrl-C (exit 130) at worst loses the one file being written this pass — the library never holds half a file's segments. A rerun resumes at near-zero cost because content-hash skipping spares unchanged files. With WAL, readers and writers never block each other: search works while a scan runs.
nodes.plain_zh: 登记卡片一张一张写：写一张、盖一张的章。中途停电，最坏坏掉手里那张，抽屉里已盖章的卡片都完好——绝不会出现半张卡（半张卡比没有卡可怕得多，检索会撞上残缺的段）。
nodes.plain_en: Catalog cards are written one at a time: finish a card, stamp a card. Power cut mid-write ruins at most the card in hand; every stamped card in the drawer is intact — a half-card can never exist (a half-card is worse than no card: retrieval would trip over mangled segments).

nodes.one_zh: 基线重生的唯一合法通道
nodes.one_en: The only legal path to rebirth a baseline
nodes.def_zh: 基线 = 冻结的历史分数（比较的锚）；gate = 每次 CI 式重跑与基线比、超阈值即红。基线确实需要重生时（语料或身份合法变化）唯一合法通道是审计门：先备份 → 重建 → 逐条对账每处差异（预期内放行、未解释的漂移追责）——杜绝「顺手夹带」。评测基线带 corpus_version + corpus_sha，语料漂移会让 gate 响亮作废，而不是静默拿旧分母比新语料。
nodes.def_en: A baseline is frozen history (the anchor of comparison); a gate is every CI-style rerun compared against it, red past a threshold. When a baseline legitimately must be reborn (corpus or identity legally changed), the audit gate is the only legal path: back up first → rebuild → account for every difference item by item (expected ones pass, unexplained drift gets chased). 'Rebuild while we're at it' smuggling is what this kills. Eval baselines carry corpus_version + corpus_sha; corpus drift voids the gate loudly rather than silently comparing an old denominator to a new corpus.
nodes.plain_zh: 成绩单锁在保险柜，平时只能对照、不能改。真到了必须重考（比如换了考场），流程是：旧成绩单复印存档 → 重考 → 每一处分差说清来历。说不清的那一分，不许悄悄抹平。
nodes.plain_en: The report card stays locked in a safe — compare against it, never edit it. When a retake is truly required (say, the exam hall changed): photocopy the old card for the archive → retake → explain every point of difference. A point you can't explain doesn't get quietly smoothed over.
nodes.example_zh: 现场范例 reports/execution/digup-p2-closeout-001/eval-rebuild-audit.md（批次 B）：8 项差异逐条归属，其中「+1 文件」查实是新命令文件落进摄取根、不是夹带；双 gate 全 0 delta、参考向量逐位复现，旧库备份保留作审计证据。

nodes.one_zh: 先冻结设计与判据再动手
nodes.one_en: Freeze the design and criteria before building
nodes.def_zh: 结构性改动前把设计、逐文件哈希、通过判据冻结成文——先承诺再动手，防止「边做边改标准」。判负就回滚：digup-plan-001 的检索改进在 DigUp 有实测正收益，goldmine 自己 A/B 后零改善，按预注册判负回滚；另一项撞了冻结基线，按规则回滚。DigUp 的数字是先验不是证明——此为铁律。批次 B 的尾窗语义偏差也明写进预注册。
nodes.def_en: Before any structural change, the design, per-file hashes, and pass criteria are frozen in writing — commit first, build second — so standards can't drift mid-flight. A loss is a rollback: digup-plan-001's retrieval tweaks had measured wins in DigUp, showed zero improvement in goldmine's own A/B, and were rolled back per preregistration; another change hit a frozen baseline and rolled back by rule. DigUp's numbers are a prior, not a proof — iron law. Batch B's tail-window semantic deviation was likewise written into its preregistration.
nodes.plain_zh: 动工前把图纸、验收标准和「什么情况算失败」白纸黑字公证一份，完工时对照公证书说话，不许赛后改标准把失败说成成功。别家工地考了 90 分，不代表你的考场一定行——各考各的。
nodes.plain_en: Notarize the blueprint, the acceptance bar, and the definition of failure before breaking ground; at handover, the notarized paper talks. No post-hoc standard editing to relabel failure as success. Another site scoring 90 proves nothing about your exam — each site takes its own test.
nodes.example_zh: 现场范例：reports/execution/digup-plan-001/ 与 digup-plan-002/（预注册 + 判负回滚全程留痕）。零改善回滚是它的标志性判例——不是「再调调」。
nodes.example_en: Live specimens: reports/execution/digup-plan-001/ and digup-plan-002/ (preregistration plus the rollback, fully on record). The zero-improvement rollback is its landmark precedent — not 'tune it some more'.

nodes.one_en: Transcript? text vector. Else raw audio
nodes.def_zh: MM-D3 路由规则：whisper 转写成功的音频，转写块同时进 FTS 并用提示词文本向量（任何文本后端都行）——文字向量更准；只有非语音内容或 whisper 缺席时才回退原始音频窗口向量。每行 info 写明「这条向量为什么存在/不存在」（如 raw:no-transcript(asr_status)）——路由决策本身是可审计的数据，不是黑盒。幻觉防护：对静音/音乐硬转会产生幻觉，转写段按置信度与字符率双门丢弃（asr_dropped 逐行记录）。
nodes.def_en: The MM-D3 routing rule: audio with a whisper transcript gets its transcript chunks into FTS AND into prompted text vectors under any text-capable backend — the text vector is more precise; only non-speech content or a missing whisper falls back to the raw audio window vector. Every row's info states why that vector exists or not (e.g. raw:no-transcript(asr_status)) — the routing decision itself is auditable data, not a black box. Hallucination guard: transcribing silence or music breeds hallucinations, so segments pass a double gate (confidence and chars-per-minute) with every drop recorded (asr_dropped).
nodes.plain_zh: 录音带先请速记员抄成文字，抄成功的按文字归档（查文字比查声音准）；实在抄不出来（纯音乐、或速记员不在），才把原始声音本身做成「声音指纹」入库。每条记录都注明走的是哪条路——账目清楚，日后才知道为什么搜得到/搜不到。
nodes.plain_en: Recordings go to a stenographer first; successful transcripts are archived as text (searching text beats searching sound). Only when transcription fails (pure music, or no stenographer available) does the raw sound itself become a 'sound print' in the archive. Every record states which route it took — clean books, so you can always tell why something is or isn't findable.
nodes.example_zh: 转写成功 → 文本段（FTS + 文字向量）；whisper 缺席 → 回退音频窗口向量，info 逐行记 asr_status。验证媒体向量未被改坏：GOLDMINE_LIVE=1 python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_reference_media_vectors.py。
nodes.example_en: Transcript present → text segments (FTS + text vectors); whisper absent → fallback audio window vectors with asr_status recorded per row. Verify media vectors are untouched: GOLDMINE_LIVE=1 python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_reference_media_vectors.py.

nodes.one_zh: 尾窗带来新内容才保留
nodes.one_en: Keep the tail only if it adds new audio
nodes.def_zh: 音频按 30 秒窗、25 秒步进分窗时，最后一个不满 30 秒的尾窗只有在携带 ≥2 秒「超出上一窗覆盖的新音频」时才保留。源码考古发现：goal prompt 写的「丢 <2s 尾窗」在 30/25 参数下字面上不可达（尾窗最短 5 秒），prompt 的 62 秒例子还与源码相反——按源码移植，偏差写进预注册。教训：「prompt 当规格」有风险，流程要求对照源码。
nodes.def_en: With 30-second windows hopping 25 seconds, the final partial tail window survives only if it carries ≥2 seconds of new audio beyond the previous window's coverage. Source archaeology revealed that the goal prompt's literal 'drop tails <2s' was unreachable dead code under 30/25 (a tail is at least 5 seconds), and its 62-second example contradicted the source — ported per source, deviation recorded in preregistration. Lesson: 'the prompt as spec' is risky; the process demands checking against source.
nodes.plain_zh: 交接班时，下一班只比上一班多听了两分钟以上，才值得把记录本续写一页；只多几秒的重复内容，上一页里已经有了。
nodes.plain_en: At shift handover, the next shift only writes a fresh log page if it heard two more minutes beyond the last shift's coverage; a few seconds of repetition already lives on the previous page.
nodes.example_zh: 30 秒窗、25 秒步进下：62 秒音频 → 窗 [0,30)、[25,55)、尾窗 [50,62) 带 7 秒新音频（超出上一窗覆盖）→ 保留；56 秒音频 → 尾窗 [50,56) 只带 1 秒新音频 → 不保留。而「尾窗长度 <2 秒」在这种参数下根本不可能出现（最短 5 秒）——这正是死代码考古的发现。
nodes.example_en: Under 30s windows / 25s hop: a 62s file → windows [0,30), [25,55), tail [50,62) carrying 7s of new audio (beyond the prior window) → kept; a 56s file → tail [50,56) carrying only 1s new → dropped. Meanwhile 'tail shorter than 2s' literally cannot occur under these parameters (minimum 5s) — exactly the dead-code finding.

nodes.one_en: Windows below −50 dB are skipped
nodes.def_zh: 均方根（RMS）≈ 响度代理；低于 0.003（约 −50 dBFS）的音频窗口没有信息，跳过不浪费嵌入。与 30 秒窗、25 秒步进的分窗配合，静音窗直接丢弃；该参数进媒体加工串（rms-gate0.003），是 DigUp 先验。它是「省钱三连」的第一道：静音门丢静音窗 → 尾门丢重复窗 → aHash 丢重复帧。
nodes.def_en: Root-mean-square approximates loudness; an audio window below 0.003 (about −50 dBFS) carries no information and is skipped rather than embedded. It works alongside 30-second windows with a 25-second hop; the constant enters the media preprocessing string (rms-gate0.003) as a DigUp prior. It is the first of the saving trio: silence gate drops silent windows → the tail gate drops repeat windows → aHash drops duplicate frames.
nodes.plain_zh: 录音里大段的「没人说话」不用请速记员记：先量一量这一段有多安静，安静到听不见的整段跳过，省时省钱。
nodes.plain_en: Long stretches of nobody talking don't need a stenographer: measure how quiet a stretch is, and skip the ones too quiet to hear — time and money saved.

nodes.one_zh: 丢字病理页的 OCR 救援与诚实回退
nodes.one_en: OCR rescue for broken Arabic pages
nodes.def_zh: 某类 PDF 的阿拉伯语文本层丢 lam-连写字形（lostLetters 病理）：显示与复制都残缺。goldmine 检测该病理并用 OCR 替换文本层。病理复现验证诚实失败：macOS 原生工具链产出的阿拉伯 PDF 全带完整 ToUnicode，造不出病——按预注册回退为合成病理 + 机制测试，真实资产记 MISSING。版本串按组合登记（如 pdftotext+arocr+visionocr@24.08.0，四种组合全部入册）。
nodes.def_en: Some PDFs' Arabic text layer loses lam-ligature glyphs (the lostLetters pathology): both display and copy come out mangled. goldmine detects the pathology and replaces the text layer via OCR. The pathology-reproduction validation failed honestly: macOS-native toolchains produce Arabic PDFs with complete ToUnicode, so the disease could not be manufactured — per preregistration it fell back to synthetic pathology plus mechanism tests, with real assets recorded MISSING. Version strings register by combination (e.g. pdftotext+arocr+visionocr@24.08.0, all four combinations on the books).
nodes.plain_zh: 有些 PDF 看着是阿拉伯文，复制出来却缺胳膊少腿。医生说治得了；想先造个病人验证疗法，结果本地根本造不出这种病人——于是老老实实记下「这种病例没验证过」，先用塑料模特练手。
nodes.plain_en: Some PDFs display Arabic fine but copy out missing limbs. The doctor claims a cure; trying to manufacture a test patient first, the lab turns out unable to produce the disease locally — so the chart honestly reads 'this case type unverified', and practice proceeds on mannequins.
nodes.example_zh: 检测在 extract_pdf.py：lostLetters = lam-连写丢失（bare alef 出现在本该连写的位置）。升级串如 pdftotext+arocr+visionocr@24.08.0 由统一组装函数按字母序拼出，注册表登记全部四种组合——组装函数与注册表同源。
nodes.example_en: Detection lives in extract_pdf.py: lostLetters means lam-ligature loss (a bare alef where a ligature belongs). Upgrade strings like pdftotext+arocr+visionocr@24.08.0 are assembled by one function in alphabetical order, with all four combinations registered — assembler and registry share a source.

nodes.one_zh: 查询期剔掉磁盘上已删的命中
nodes.one_en: Drop hits whose files vanished
nodes.def_zh: A2 规则（2026-10-25 批次 A）：候选集确定后、取前 limit 之前，对文件来源的候选查一次磁盘存在性，已删的剔掉并计数（settings.deleted_filtered，--json 与 MCP 都能看到）。两个刻意限定：URL 行豁免（网页在不在磁盘没意义）；只管本索引真实摄取过的目录范围（roots_json）内的行——离线测试用假路径建库，不该被误伤。发生在 limit 之前 = 取前 20 条的前提是「全是活文件」，预算不因死文件缩水。第一版被对抗评审拦下，改为 roots 内过滤后才放行。
nodes.def_en: The A2 rule (2026-10-25, batch A): after the candidate set, before the top-limit cut, file-backed candidates get one disk-existence check; deleted ones are dropped and counted (settings.deleted_filtered, visible in --json and MCP). Two deliberate scopes: URL rows are exempt (a web page's disk presence is meaningless); only rows inside roots_json — the directories this index really ingested — are filtered, because offline tests build libraries with fake paths and must not be collateral damage. Running before the limit means 'top 20' promises 20 live files — the budget never shrinks to dead weight. nodes.plain_zh: 报出的每条结果都答应「现在点得开」。查无此物的就别端上桌，还得数清楚剔了几条。但只在自己管辖的文件夹里核对——别人家测试用的假门牌，不归这条规矩管。

nodes.def_zh: macOS 的 st_flags 标志位里 SF_DATALESS（0x40000000）=「iCloud 占位，实体在云上」。对这种文件 open() 即触发下载（可能几百 MB、要走网络）。所以拦截必须在一切会 open 的操作（包括格式嗅探）之前，用 lstat 看标志而不打开文件。Python 的 stat 模块不导出 SF_DATALESS，代码显式定义（walk.py:63）。文件符号链跟到目标后查的是目标的标志——符号链进 iCloud Drive 也拦得住。
nodes.def_en: Among macOS's st_flags sits SF_DATALESS (0x40000000) = 'iCloud placeholder, body in the cloud'. Opening such a file triggers a download — possibly hundreds of MB over the network. So the interception must precede any open() (format sniffing included), reading flags via lstat without opening. Python's stat module doesn't export SF_DATALESS; the code defines it explicitly (walk.py:63). File symlinks are followed and the target's flags checked — symlinks into iCloud Drive get caught too.
nodes.plain_zh: 云盘文件夹里有很多「空盒子」：看一眼标签就知道是什么，但真要打开，就得现场从云端搬货——又慢又费流量。规矩：先看标签，是空盒子就绕着走，绝对不手贱打开。
nodes.plain_en: Cloud folders hold many 'empty boxes': the label tells you what's inside, but opening one triggers a delivery from the cloud — slow and data-hungry. The rule: read the label, and if it's an empty box, walk around it. Never, ever open it.

nodes.one_zh: inode 没变只是搬家，不重嵌
nodes.one_en: Same inode elsewhere: moved, not deleted
nodes.def_zh: inode = 文件系统里文件的唯一编号，改名、挪目录都不变。删除检测时「路径消失但 POSIX 身份（dev+ino+大小+mtime）出现在本轮候选里」= 移动而非删除——改个路径保住全部已嵌内容，不删不重嵌。配套守卫：根/子树不可读 ≠ 空（弹出硬盘、TCC 弹窗绝不能读成「全删了」），unreachable 前缀守卫保留这些行。收尾挂在每波摄取之后：moves = walk.detect_moves(self.store, resolved_roots, candidates)。
nodes.def_en: An inode is the filesystem's unique number for a file — renaming or moving directories never changes it. During deletion detection, 'path vanished but its POSIX identity (dev+ino+size+mtime) appears among this round's candidates' means moved, not deleted — update the path and keep every embedded vector, no deletion, no re-embedding. Companion guard: an unreadable root/subtree is not empty (an ejected drive or a TCC dialog must never read as 'user deleted everything'); an unreachable-prefix guard preserves those rows. It runs at the tail of every ingest wave: moves = walk.detect_moves(self.store, resolved_roots, candidates).
nodes.plain_zh: 你把车从车库挪到路边，车牌没变。系统记车牌不记车位——车牌还在城里出现，就知道你是搬家不是卖车，整套保养记录照用。但如果是整个车库大门打不开（硬盘弹出了），绝不能断定车都卖了。
nodes.plain_en: You moved the car from the garage to the curb; the plate didn't change. The system tracks plates, not parking spots — the plate still appears in town, so you moved, you didn't sell, and the whole maintenance record survives. But if the entire garage door won't open (drive ejected), that proves nothing about the cars.
nodes.example_zh: pipeline.py 的收尾：moves = walk.detect_moves(...)——截图工具把截图挪进项目目录是常态场景，零重嵌成本。roots_json 合并把本轮范围记账进库，也是查询期 A2 过滤「只在 roots 内管」的数据来源。
nodes.example_en: In pipeline.py's tail: moves = walk.detect_moves(...) — screenshot tools moving shots into project folders is routine, at zero re-embedding cost. The roots_json merge records this round's scope, which also feeds the query-time A2 filter's 'only within roots' rule.

nodes.def_zh: 目录行走的三大门禁，全部刻意确定性：①跳过表——构建产物目录（build/target/dist/out/.next）、密钥、许可文件、压缩包（zip 炸弹面）不索引，理由逐条写在 rules.py；②符号链政策——目录符号链永不跟随（防 a→b→a 死循环），文件符号链跟到内容；③顺序钉死——roots 与每个目录的 entries 都 sorted，单线程行走：同样的磁盘永远产出同样的候选序列，重跑才敢跳过、对比才有意义。
nodes.def_en: Three gates on the directory walk, all deliberately deterministic: (1) skip lists — build-output folders (build/target/dist/out/.next), secrets, licenses, and archives (the zip-bomb surface) are never indexed, each reason documented in rules.py; (2) symlink policy — directory symlinks are never followed (breaking a→b→a loops) while file symlinks follow to content; (3) pinned order — roots and every directory's entries are sorted, single-threaded: identical disks always yield the identical candidate sequence, which is what makes rerun-skipping and comparison meaningful.
nodes.plain_zh: 进仓库前的门卫规矩：一是「这些货架不查」清单（建材堆、保险柜、废料桶）；二是「传送门只进一次」——指回自己的传送门绝不踩，否则原地打转；三是查货顺序永远固定——今天从左到右，明天也从左到右，两次清点的差异才是真差异。
nodes.plain_en: The warehouse doorman's rules: first, a 'don't audit these shelves' list (building materials, the safe, scrap bins); second, 'each magic door only once' — a door pointing back at itself is never stepped through, or you loop forever; third, the audit order is always fixed — left to right today, left to right tomorrow, so any difference between two audits is a real difference.
nodes.example_zh: walk.py 头注释：Deterministic (sorted), single-threaded on purpose；目录符号链 continue（V5c symlink policy）。rules.py 的 SKIP_FOLDERS / SECRET_EXTS / ARCHIVE_EXTS 逐条带理由。

nodes.one_zh: 分波抽取，先哈希再跳过未变文件
nodes.one_en: Wave by wave; hash before skipping
nodes.def_zh: 摄取按波次推进：每波取 max(workers×8, 16) 个候选，先对整波算 sha256，与库里存的内容哈希一致且版本新鲜的文件整波跳过（G10 语义）——「Ctrl-C 安全、重跑续传」的机制本体。波内每个文件一个事务；波与波之间做移动检测与范围记账。内容变了才重抽，抽取行为变了靠版本串判定重抽——两条线合起来，重跑成本永远正比于「真正变化的部分」。
nodes.def_en: Ingest advances in waves: each wave takes max(workers×8, 16) candidates, hashes the whole wave's sha256 first, and skips files whose stored content hash matches with fresh versions (the G10 semantics) — the machinery behind 'Ctrl-C safe, rerun resumes'. Within a wave, one transaction per file; between waves, move detection and scope bookkeeping. Only changed content re-extracts; changed extractor behavior re-extracts via version strings — together, rerun cost always stays proportional to what actually changed.
nodes.plain_zh: 搬家装车分批来：每批先扫码（哈希）——箱子里东西没变的整批原样搬过，不拆箱重装。中途歇了？已装车的都在，下一车从断点继续。
nodes.plain_en: Moving house proceeds in loads: scan (hash) each load first — boxes whose contents haven't changed move over sealed, never repacked. Took a break? Everything loaded stays loaded; the next truck continues from the breakpoint.
nodes.example_zh: pipeline.py: wave = max(int(self.cfg.ingest.workers) * 8, 16)；先 hashes = [sha256_file(c.path) for c in wave_items] 再决定跳过。重跑摄取日志可见 skipped/extracted 计数。
nodes.example_en: pipeline.py: wave = max(int(self.cfg.ingest.workers) * 8, 16); hashes = [sha256_file(c.path) for c in wave_items] run before any skip decision. Rerun-ingest logs show the skipped/extracted counts.

nodes.def_zh: goldmine estimate <root> 摄取大目录前的预期管理：复用与摄取同一套行走规则与跳过表，读元数据（walk 计数、pdfinfo 页数、ffprobe 时长），按 DigUp 在 M4 Pro 上实测的速率常数（2026-10-07）折算时间——速率标注为 DigUp 先验，goldmine 校准待做。只读是结构保证：命令根本没有 --db 参数面，物理上写不了任何库。降级必须大声：缺 pdfinfo 时明说「按每本 PDF 10 页的先验估的」。

nodes.one_en: Reader leaves; the writer's next byte has nowhere to go
nodes.def_zh: goldmine search | head 里 head 拿够就走，goldmine 再写时内核回 EPIPE，默认行为是 SIGPIPE 信号杀死进程。Python 把 SIGPIPE 转成 BrokenPipeError，但要主动接住才能安静退出。深层坑：小输出躺在用户态缓冲区没进管道，执行期不报错，只在解释器退出 flush 时爆（退出码 120）——修法 = 执行期 handler + 退出前主动 flush 探针（师承 DigUp IndexService.swift:331-336 的 EPIPE 纪律）。边车一侧同款纪律：吞 EPIPE + 忽略 SIGPIPE。
nodes.def_en: In 'goldmine search | head', head leaves once it has enough; goldmine's next write gets EPIPE from the kernel, whose default is death by SIGPIPE. Python converts SIGPIPE into BrokenPipeError, but you must catch it to exit quietly. The deep trap: small output still sits in userspace buffers, nothing errors during execution, and the explosion waits until interpreter-shutdown flush (exit code 120) — the fix is a runtime handler plus a deliberate pre-exit flush probe (inherited from DigUp's IndexService.swift:331-336 EPIPE discipline). The sidecar carries the same discipline: swallow EPIPE, ignore SIGPIPE.
nodes.plain_zh: 你往传送带上放包裹，对面收货的下班了。放的那一刻传送带还转着（东西堆在缓冲区），等你下班前最后一搬才听见「对面早没人了」的警报——这时想体面收工已经晚了。所以收工前主动按一下警报器试试。
nodes.plain_en: You keep loading the conveyor, but the receiver went home. The belt still moves while you load (goods pile in the buffer); only at your own end-of-day move does the alarm sound — 'nobody's there!' — too late for a graceful exit. So press the alarm deliberately before clocking out.

nodes.example_en: 'python3 -m goldmine search x --db evals/eval.sqlite | head -1' should exit quietly (rc=0) — no traceback, not rc=120. Tests: python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_epipe.py.

nodes.one_zh: 缓冲预读会饿死 poll，须裸读
nodes.one_en: Buffered reads starve poll; use raw reads
nodes.def_zh: poll = 问内核「这个 fd 现在有数据吗」（level-triggered：有就一直报有）。BufferedReader 会预读——把管道里的数据提前搬进自己的内部缓冲，poll 看管道永远空 → 永远不醒（观测过的真事故：ready 行被 BufferedReader 吃掉、poll 饿死、启动超时）。所以边车协议读必须用裸 fd 的 os.read，要多少读多少。这是边车「四条命」之二，注释原话：Raw os.read on the fd — NEVER the BufferedReader。
nodes.def_en: poll asks the kernel 'does this fd have data now' (level-triggered: reports readiness as long as data remains). BufferedReader prefetches — hauling pipe data into its internal buffer ahead of time, so the pipe always looks empty to poll, which never wakes (an observed real incident: the ready line eaten by the BufferedReader, poll starved, startup timed out). Hence the sidecar protocol must read with raw-fd os.read, taking exactly what is needed. Sidecar rule of survival #2; the comment verbatim: 'Raw os.read on the fd — NEVER the BufferedReader'.
nodes.plain_zh: 你雇了个跑腿的盯着信箱（poll 只认信箱），又让实习生「顺手」把信箱里的信先拿进屋里——跑腿的一直盯着空信箱，永远不报告有信。规矩：要一封，亲手只拿一封。
nodes.plain_en: You hire a runner to watch the mailbox (poll only knows the mailbox), then let an intern 'helpfully' carry the mail indoors — the runner stares at an empty mailbox forever and never reports. The rule: need one letter, personally take exactly one letter.

nodes.def_zh: Model Context Protocol 服务器（官方 SDK mcp 2.0.0，stdio transport），只提供 goldmine_search / goldmine_get / goldmine_context / goldmine_status 四个工具。刻意的限制：只读（不创建索引、不导入资料、不改客户端配置）；get/context 只收搜索返回的 gm1:... 引用，不收路径/URL/SQL；引用内容变化返回 stale_citation；照片名称/元数据标注 name_metadata，不伪装成图像描述；deadline 默认 fast 5 秒 / quality 10 秒，取消传播到检查点。材料包预算沿用 pack 契约（512–32768）。
nodes.def_en: A Model Context Protocol server (official SDK mcp 2.0.0, stdio transport) exposing exactly four tools: goldmine_search / goldmine_get / goldmine_context / goldmine_status. Deliberate restrictions: read-only (creates no index, ingests nothing, touches no client config); get/context accept only gm1:... citations returned by search — never paths, URLs, or SQL; changed citation content returns stale_citation; photo names/metadata are labeled name_metadata, never disguised as image descriptions; deadlines default to fast 5s / quality 10s with cancellation propagated to checkpoints. The pack budget follows the pack contract (512–32768).

nodes.def_en: serve (opt-in): a resident backend plus heartbeat socket plus linger timeout auto-exit; search drops from 'spawn the model for seconds each time' to sub-second; capability/fingerprint info merges from static probes — visual_search is answered truthfully without spawning anything. watch (opt-in): FSEvents → quiet-window merging → incremental ingest (only changed files redone); a full_period_s of 21600 (6 hours) as the full-scan fallback; a poison-file list (repeated delta failures stop retrying; the full scan counts separately); power gating (no backend on battery); a backend that fails to start doesn't crash — reason recorded, retry next time.

nodes.one_en: One of four honest labels per file
nodes.def_zh: 每个文件的能力行四选一：content_indexed（真读真嵌）/ metadata_only（只有名字可搜，原因写明：OCR 缺、ffmpeg 缺、后端无图嵌入）/ unsupported（刻意不读：密钥、许可、构建目录——带原因）/ failed（试了没成——带原因）。没有「差不多算读过了」这一栏。metadata_only 的行仍可被搜到——靠文件名进 FTS。visual_search 这类能力布尔由静态探针派生（helper+mmproj 能解析才 true），不许配置写死。
nodes.def_en: Every file's capability row is one of four: content_indexed (truly read and embedded), metadata_only (only the name is searchable, reason stated: OCR missing, ffmpeg missing, backend can't embed images), unsupported (deliberately unread: secrets, licenses, build dirs — reason stated), failed (tried and didn't make it — reason stated). There is no 'roughly read' column. metadata_only rows remain findable via filename in FTS. Capability booleans like visual_search derive from static probes (true only when helper+mmproj resolve) — never hardcoded config.

nodes.one_zh: 宁可少说，不可说谎
nodes.one_en: Understate rather than lie
nodes.def_zh: 横切全部模块的设计纪律：宁可少说不可说谎，宁可报 UNKNOWN 不可装知道。七条正文：能力行不说谎；零命中是合法答案（exit 0）；指纹不符拒绝服务（exit 3）；降级必须大声（estimate 缺 pdfinfo 时明说「按 10 页/PDF 估的」）；不可读 ≠ 空；部分失败是记账不是灾难（exit 5）；证据三态。收益是信任可以局部重建——任何一行输出都能沿明示链路查到底。每条静默降级比诚实降级省二十行代码，省到最后没人知道系统什么时候在瞎说。
nodes.def_en: A design discipline cutting across every module: understate rather than lie; report UNKNOWN rather than bluff. Seven clauses: capability rows never lie; zero hits is a legal answer (exit 0); fingerprint mismatch refuses service (exit 3); degradation must be loud (estimate without pdfinfo says 'assumed 10 pages/PDF'); unreadable ≠ empty; partial failure is bookkeeping, not disaster (exit 5); three-state evidence. The payoff: trust can be rebuilt locally — every output line traces down an explicit chain. Each silent degradation saves twenty lines over an honest one; save enough and nobody knows when the system is bluffing.
nodes.plain_zh: 店里没有的货就说没有，绝不拿别的凑；暂时不知道就说不知道。这样客人随时可以抽查任何一句话——查得动，才信得过。
nodes.plain_en: If the shop doesn't stock it, say so — never substitute something similar; if you don't know yet, say you don't know. Customers can spot-check any sentence you say; checkable is believable.
nodes.example_zh: 降级大声的例子：estimate 缺 pdfinfo 时明说「按 10 页/PDF 估的」；watch 后端没起来时报告里写 reason；后端不支持图片时 NotSupported 直说（serve/mcp/llama 三处文案逐字一致，有对照测试）。抽查：python3 -m goldmine status --db evals/eval.sqlite --json。
nodes.example_en: Loud degradations: estimate without pdfinfo says 'assumed 10 pages/PDF'; a watch backend that failed to start writes its reason into the report; an unsupported image gets a plain NotSupported (serve/mcp/llama share the wording verbatim, pinned by a comparison test). Spot-check: python3 -m goldmine status --db evals/eval.sqlite --json.

nodes.one_en: PASS, FAIL, or MISSING — nothing between
nodes.def_zh: 记录层的证据纪律：PASS 必须带原始回执（命令行、退出码、输出哈希、前后源码身份）；FAIL 如实记；证据不可得记 MISSING。「基本通过」是禁语。动机：开发主力是 AI 会话，AI 的失败模式是「自信地编」——三态让「编」在流程里活不过验证关。
nodes.def_en: The evidence discipline for records: PASS must carry the original receipt (command line, exit code, output hash, before/after source identity); FAIL is recorded as it happened; unobtainable evidence is MISSING. 'Basically passed' is banned vocabulary. Rationale: the workforce is AI sessions, whose failure mode is confident fabrication — three states make fabrication unable to survive verification.
nodes.plain_zh: 施工验收只有三种盖章：合格（附验收单原件）、不合格、没验成（附原因）。没有「差不多合格」这种章——章一模糊，下次就有人拿它当合格用。
nodes.plain_en: Construction sign-off has exactly three stamps: passed (with the original inspection sheet), failed, not-inspected (with the reason). There is no 'basically passed' stamp — once a stamp blurs, someone will use it as passed.
nodes.example_zh: MISSING 的活例：阿拉伯病理复现——真实资产记 MISSING，用合成病理 + 机制测试顶上。PASS 的活例：docs/ANCHORS.md 六条命令每条都实跑过并附「怎么读输出」。

nodes.one_zh: 每个 AI 会话独立分支，合并经用户
nodes.one_en: Each AI session works on its own branch
nodes.def_zh: 制度化为 AGENTS.md 铁律：每个 AI 会话在独立分支干活，合并经用户。起源是撞车事件：最终全量测试突然冒出陌生失败，排查发现另一个 AI 会话在同一工作树并行干活——27 个评测文件被改成占位符路径。处理：把对方的 27 个文件 stash 出去 → 失败全恢复绿（归因成立）→ 白名单提交自己的文件（一行不吞）→ stash 由对方自己消费。教训同时衍生出 flaky 处置纪律：单独重跑 3 次；怀疑新改动时用 stash A/B 归因，比「重跑到绿」诚实。
nodes.def_en: Codified as an AGENTS.md iron law: every AI session works on its own branch, merges go through the user. It was born in a collision: the full test run suddenly grew strange failures; investigation found another AI session working the same tree in parallel — 27 eval files rewritten to placeholder paths. Resolution: stash the other session's 27 files → all failures turned green (attribution confirmed) → whitelist-commit only one's own files (not one line of the other's) → the stash consumed by its owner. It also spawned the flaky-test discipline: rerun alone 3 times; suspect your own change and attribute it with a stash A/B — more honest than 'rerun until green'.
nodes.plain_zh: 两位装修师傅不能同时在同一面墙上干活——刷的刷、凿的凿，谁也不知道墙面最后什么样。各干各的墙（分支），完工后由房东验收合并。出了问题先把对方的工具搬走再验：墙好了，就是他的责任；还坏，才是我的。
nodes.plain_en: Two painters can't work the same wall at once — one brushing, one chiseling, nobody knows what the wall ends up as. Each takes a wall (a branch); the landlord inspects and merges. When something breaks, first move the other painter's tools aside and re-check: wall fine → their doing; still broken → mine.
nodes.example_zh: 归因实验流程：git stash 掉对方改动 → 重跑失败测试 → 全绿即归因成立。今天的翻版：全量测试见陌生失败时，拿着测试名去问会话要归因（docs/ANCHORS.md 第 6 条）。
nodes.example_en: The attribution drill: git stash the other session's changes → rerun the failing tests → all green means attribution confirmed. Today's version: on strange failures in the full suite, take the test name and demand attribution (docs/ANCHORS.md card 6).

nodes.def_zh: docs/ANCHORS.md 的六条命令：每条都实跑过并附「怎么读输出」——指纹拒现场（第 2 条：differs in: media、rc=3）、参考向量逐位复现（第 3 条：GOLDMINE_LIVE=1，2 passed 2 skipped）、陌生失败的归因流程（第 6 条）。目的：让「验证」摆脱对任何会话记忆的依赖——用户亲手可跑、亲手可读，AI 的转述只是旁注。这是理解密度制度（锚点卡 → 五讲轮讲 → 人读 diff 摘要）的第一层。
nodes.def_en: Six commands in docs/ANCHORS.md: each actually run, each with a 'how to read the output' note — the fingerprint-refusal scene (card 2: differs in: media, rc=3), bit-exact reference vectors (card 3: GOLDMINE_LIVE=1, 2 passed 2 skipped), and the attribution drill for strange failures (card 6). The purpose: verification that depends on no session's memory — the user can run and read them firsthand; any AI retelling is a side note. nodes.def_zh: FTS5 是 SQLite 内置的全文索引，本质是倒排索引：词 → 含它的行，像书后的索引页。BM25 是它的排名公式——查询词越稀有、在文档中出现越密、文档越短，排名越靠前。本项目只用 BM25 的排名（词法臂），从不把它的分值加进最终分数：BM25 低 = 好，方向与最终分数相反。词覆盖率 coverage（查询词在文件中的覆盖比例）是这条臂对融合的真正贡献。
nodes.def_en: FTS5 is SQLite's built-in full-text index — an inverted index mapping each word to the rows containing it, like a book's index pages. BM25 is its ranking formula: rarer query words, denser occurrences, and shorter documents rank higher. This project uses BM25's ranking only (the lexical arm); its raw score is never added to the final score — BM25 is lower-is-better, the opposite direction. Word coverage (the fraction of query words present in the file) is this arm's real contribution to fusion.
nodes.plain_zh: 一本书后面的索引页：「关键词 → 第几页」。翻索引比翻全书快得多。BM25 是给命中结果排队的规矩：命中一个全书只有三处提到的生僻词，比命中满篇都是的「的」值钱得多。
nodes.plain_en: The index pages at the back of a book: 'keyword → page numbers'. Flipping the index beats reading the whole book. BM25 is the queuing rule for hits: matching a word that appears three times in the whole book is worth far more than matching one that's on every page.

nodes.example_en: Search 'TRX50' (a motherboard model number): the semantic model doesn't know the number — only FTS5 hits it exactly. nodes.def_zh: embeddinggemma 这类模型要求输入带固定模板：查询侧 'task: search result | query: {text}'，文档侧 'title: {title} | text: {text}'（base.py 的 QUERY_PROMPT / DOCUMENT_PROMPT）。穿错外衣向量就变味——所以 prompts 是指纹八字段之一。细分纪律：文档提示词进 embed_id（它变了，每个存量向量的取值都变，必须全量重嵌），查询提示词不进（只影响查询那一个向量，零重嵌）。2026-10 的 v1→v2 提示词重构因此是零重嵌迁移；同月给代码文件加标题提示词的 A/B 零改善，按预注册回滚。
nodes.def_en: Models like embeddinggemma require fixed templates: the query side 'task: search result | query: {text}', the document side 'title: {title} | text: {text}' (QUERY_PROMPT / DOCUMENT_PROMPT in base.py). The wrong coat changes the vector's flavor — hence prompts are one of the fingerprint's eight fields. A fine-grained rule: the document prompt enters embed_id (change it and every stored vector's value changes → full re-embed) while the query prompt doesn't (it only changes the one query vector → zero re-embeds). The 2026-10 v1→v2 prompt refactor was thus a zero-re-embed migration; that same month, an A/B adding title prompts to code files showed zero change and was rolled back per preregistration.

nodes.one_zh: 权重压成 8 位整数，小一半快数倍
nodes.one_en: Weights squeezed to 8-bit integers
nodes.def_zh: 神经网络权重本是 16 位浮点；量化把它们压成 8 位整数（Q8_0 是 llama.cpp 的 8 位格式，_0 表示对称分组，组内共享缩放因子摊薄误差），装在 GGUF 单文件容器里。模型文件约 1.5GB → 约 800MB，推理快数倍，精度损失极小。更激进的 Q4 精度损失开始可测；F16 被明确禁止——同模型家族实测激活值溢出 float16，记录在案。whisper 走同一思路：large-v3-turbo 的 Q5_0。
nodes.def_en: Neural weights are natively 16-bit floats; quantization packs them into 8-bit integers (Q8_0 is llama.cpp's 8-bit scheme; _0 means symmetric blocks sharing one scale factor to spread out error) inside the GGUF single-file container. The model file drops from ~1.5GB to ~800MB, inference gets several times faster, and accuracy barely moves. More aggressive Q4 starts measurably losing accuracy; F16 is explicitly banned — measured activation overflow in this model family, on the record. whisper follows the same route with a Q5_0 large-v3-turbo.
nodes.plain_zh: 把一本用超大字号印的书换成紧凑排版：内容几乎一字不丢，纸省一半、翻起来更快。数字本来就没用到那么高的精度，砍掉尾巴不伤内容。但也不能砍太狠——再砍一档（Q4）就开始真丢内容了。
nodes.plain_en: Reprint a book in large font as a compact edition: barely a word lost, half the paper, much faster to flip through. The numbers never used that much precision, so trimming the tail costs nothing. But don't overdo it — one notch tighter (Q4) and content really starts to leak.

nodes.def_zh: embeddinggemma 是文本模型，看不见图片；mmproj 是配套投影头，把图片/音频编码器的输出投影进文本向量同一个 768 维空间——「一张猫的照片」从此能和「猫」这个词比夹角。这是多模态搜索的全部秘密：一切都被搬到同一空间。mmproj 文件的 sha256 进指纹（媒体四件套之一），且只在 helper 与 mmproj 都能解析时才附加——纯文本安装的指纹逐字节不变。
nodes.def_en: embeddinggemma is a text model and cannot see images; mmproj is the companion projection head that maps image/audio encoder outputs into the same 768-dim space as text vectors — 'a photo of a cat' can now be angled against the word 'cat'. That is the entire secret of multimodal search: everything is moved into one space. The mmproj file's sha256 enters the fingerprint (one of the media four), attached only when both helper and mmproj resolve — a text-only install keeps a byte-identical fingerprint.
nodes.plain_zh: 要比较就得说同一种「坐标语言」。图片和声音本来各有各的方言，mmproj 是翻译官，把它们统统翻译到文字用的那套坐标系里。翻译官换人（模型文件变），所有翻译结果都要重来。
nodes.plain_en: You can only compare things speaking the same coordinate language. Images and sound each have their own dialect; mmproj is the interpreter who translates both into the coordinate system words use. Replace the interpreter (a different model file) and every translation must be redone.

nodes.one_en: One-file database with write-ahead log
nodes.def_zh: SQLite 是单文件数据库——整个索引（段表、FTS5 表、向量 BLOB、元数据）就是一个 .sqlite 文件。WAL（预写日志）模式让读写不互相阻塞：写先落到 -wal 伴生文件，读方看稳定的主文件，检查点时再合并——扫描进行中也能随时搜索。事务在这之上提供原子性：本项目一文件一事务，崩溃最坏丢一个文件的这一次。
nodes.def_en: SQLite is a single-file database — the whole index (segments, FTS5 tables, vector BLOBs, metadata) is one .sqlite file. WAL (write-ahead logging) lets readers and writers not block each other: writes land in the -wal companion first while readers see the stable main file, merging at checkpoints — search works mid-scan. Transactions add atomicity on top: one transaction per file here, so a crash at worst loses one file's current pass.
nodes.plain_zh: 整个图书馆的目录卡片装在一个抽屉里，搬家只需端走一个抽屉。WAL 是「先在便签上记一笔、稍后正式誊写」的记账法——有人查账时不必等誊写完。
nodes.plain_en: The whole library catalog lives in one drawer — moving house means carrying one drawer. WAL is bookkeeping on sticky notes first, formal ledger later — nobody reading the ledger waits for the scribe.

nodes.example_en: You can see eval.sqlite-wal / -shm companions next to the database — WAL mode's footprints. Cut power right now and the worst loss is the one file being written this pass; rerun ingest and every file whose sha256 hasn't changed is skipped.

nodes.one_zh: 768 个浮点压成 1536 字节存库
nodes.one_en: Vectors stored as half-precision blobs
nodes.def_zh: 存储合同（D7）：768 个 float32 向量压成 1536 字节的小端 float16 BLOB 落库（util.pack_fp16 / unpack_fp16），检索时按 8192 行的块批量还原成 float32 再算余弦。权衡：存储减半、缓存更友好，fp16 的 10 位尾数对归一化向量的余弦排序无影响——这是「存储侧量化」，与模型权重的 Q8_0 是同一家族的两个决定，各自独立钉进合同。
nodes.def_en: The storage contract (D7): each 768-float32 vector packs into a 1536-byte little-endian float16 BLOB (util.pack_fp16 / unpack_fp16); at query time it unpacks back to float32 in 8192-row blocks before the cosine. The tradeoff: half the storage and friendlier caching, while fp16's 10-bit mantissa leaves cosine ordering of normalized vectors untouched — a 'storage-side quantization' in the same family as the model weights' Q8_0, each pinned independently into the contract.
nodes.plain_zh: 仓库里每件行李用真空袋压缩一半再上架——省一半货架，需要用时拆开还原。日常清点按 8192 件一批拆。压缩是「有损但无损到点子上」：省掉的那几位小数，根本影响不了谁排前面。
nodes.plain_en: Every suitcase in storage goes into a vacuum bag, halved on the shelf — half the racks, unpacked on demand, 8192 items to a batch. The compression 'loses bits that don't matter': the trimmed decimal digits can't change who ranks first.

nodes.one_zh: 数据变一位，指纹面目全非

nodes.def_zh: SHA-256 把任意数据映射为 64 位十六进制摘要；输入变一位，输出面目全非（雪崩效应）。本项目的三处用途：摄取每波先比对文件内容是否变化（未变则跳过，G10 语义）；给模型文件验明正身（model_sha256、mmproj_sha256 进指纹）；作为指纹身份本身的哈希原料（canonical 字节串 → sha256[:16]）。一处实现、三种身份用途——都吃「雪崩」这碗饭。
nodes.def_en: SHA-256 maps any data to a 64-hex-digit digest; flip one input bit and the output is unrecognizable (avalanche effect). Three uses here: each ingest wave compares file content before extraction (unchanged means skipped — the G10 semantics); model files are verified (model_sha256 and mmproj_sha256 go into the fingerprint); and the fingerprint's own identity is the sha256 (first 16 hex chars) of the canonical byte string. One implementation, three identity duties — all fed by the avalanche.
nodes.plain_zh: 给文件拍一张「指纹照」：哪怕只多了一个逗号，照片就完全认不出来。所以「照片没变」基本等于「文件没变」——重跑摄取时一眼判断哪些文件不用再看第二遍。
nodes.plain_en: Photograph a file's fingertips: add one comma and the photo is unrecognizable. 'Photo unchanged' therefore means 'file unchanged' — a rerun can tell at a glance which files never need a second look.
nodes.example_zh: 每波摄取先算候选文件 sha256，与库里存的内容哈希一致且版本新鲜 → 跳过——这就是「Ctrl-C 安全、重跑续传」。看嵌入身份：python3 -m goldmine status --db evals/eval.sqlite --json 里的 current.embed_id 即由这些 sha 派生。
nodes.example_en: Each wave hashes candidates first; a matching stored hash with fresh versions means skip — that's 'Ctrl-C safe, rerun resumes'. See identity at work: in python3 -m goldmine status --db evals/eval.sqlite --json, current.embed_id is derived from exactly these shas.

nodes.one_zh: 语音转文字，Q5 量化本地跑
nodes.one_en: Speech to text, Q5, fully local
nodes.def_zh: ASR（自动语音识别）用 whisper-cli（whisper.cpp）跑 large-v3-turbo 的 Q5_0 量化模型；音频先经 ffmpeg 转 16kHz 单声道 wav，再 whisper-cli --vad（挂 silero VAD）转写。幻觉防护双门：段内 token 平均置信度 < 0.50 丢弃、字符率 < 20 字/分钟丢弃（对静音/音乐硬转会产生幻觉），asr_dropped 逐行记录。转写段合并成 ≤40 秒 / ≤~450 est-token 的块（与文本块同一 token 预算，F8 修正），行为变化由 asr-whisper.v2 版本串标记。一次只允许一个 whisper 进程（实测两个并发会与 Metal 上的 llama-server 相撞）。
nodes.def_en: ASR (automatic speech recognition) runs whisper-cli (whisper.cpp) with a Q5_0 large-v3-turbo; audio first becomes 16kHz mono wav via ffmpeg, then whisper-cli --vad (with silero VAD) transcribes. A double hallucination gate: segments with mean token confidence < 0.50 are dropped, and under 20 chars/minute are dropped (transcribing silence or music breeds hallucination), every drop recorded as asr_dropped. Surviving segments merge into ≤40 s / ≤ ~450 est-token chunks (the same token budget as text chunks, the F8 fix), with behavior changes marked by the asr-whisper.v2 version string. One whisper at a time — two concurrent instances measurably collided with llama-server on Metal.
nodes.plain_zh: 本地请的一位速记员：先把录音统一成「电话音质」，再只记有人说话的段。对空白和音乐硬记，他会自己编出话来（这叫幻觉）——所以他自带两道自查：这段记得没底气（置信度低）就撕掉，一分钟连 20 个字都记不出（多半是音乐）也撕掉，撕了几张都记账。
nodes.plain_en: A locally hired stenographer: normalize the recording to 'telephone quality' first, then take only the parts with speech. Forced to take silence or music, he invents sentences (that's hallucination) — so he self-checks twice: pages he had no confidence in get torn up, and pages under 20 characters a minute (probably music) get torn up, with every torn page logged.

nodes.def_zh: VAD（语音活动检测）用 silero-vad-v5.1.2 模型，作为 whisper-cli 的 --vad -vm 参数在转写前标出「哪些段有人声」——省得对静音/音乐硬转（那会喂出幻觉）。与 RMS 静音门的分工：RMS 量「有多安静」（能量统计，免费），silero 判「是不是人声」（学习模型，更准）——一个在窗口级丢弃无声，一个在转写级定位人声。
nodes.def_en: VAD (voice activity detection) uses the silero-vad-v5.1.2 model, passed to whisper-cli via --vad -vm, marking which spans contain speech before transcription — sparing silence and music from forced transcription (which feeds hallucination). nodes.one_en: macOS Vision reads text inside images
nodes.def_zh: 光学字符识别把图片/扫描页里的字变成可搜文本。本项目用 macOS 系统 Vision 框架（经 Python helper 调用）做截图/扫描页的 OCR，走批处理：多张截图的请求汇进一个批次，由 _leader 线程一次性 spawn helper，省掉每图一次的进程启动与 Vision 冷启动。OCR 可用性逐页记录（ocr_page_states），从不可用变可用触发 redo 重抽。PDF 页先由 pdftoppm 渲染成图再 OCR——与 poppler 是流水线搭档。
nodes.def_en: Optical character recognition turns text inside images and scanned pages into searchable text. This project uses macOS's system Vision framework (called through a Python helper) for screenshots and scanned pages, batched: many screenshot requests pool into one batch and a _leader thread spawns the helper once, saving per-image process startup and Vision cold starts. Per-page availability is recorded (ocr_page_states); unavailable→available transitions trigger a redo re-extraction. PDF pages are first rendered to images by pdftoppm then OCR'd — pipeline partners with poppler.

nodes.def_zh: ffmpeg 负责解码与转码（音频转 16kHz 单声道 wav 供 whisper、视频抽帧）、ffprobe 负责探时长与流信息（estimate 的折算原料）。一次真实基准驱动的选型：ffmpeg vs macOS 原生 AVFoundation——本机测出 ffmpeg 全核并行更快（5 分钟 1080p：3.88s vs 4.07s）但全内占视频更慢（2.10s vs 0.60s），最终留 ffmpeg：跨平台（Win/Mac/Linux）+ 格式覆盖（ogg/opus/wma/avi/mkv/webm）值这个权衡，AVFoundation 记录为条件性备胎。外部进程纪律：run_tool 有界运行、超时与 stderr 尾巴带回。
nodes.def_en: ffmpeg handles decode and transcode (audio to 16kHz mono wav for whisper, video frame extraction); ffprobe probes durations and stream info (estimate's raw material). A benchmark-driven choice: ffmpeg vs macOS-native AVFoundation — locally, ffmpeg won on full-core parallel decode (5-min 1080p: 3.88s vs 4.07s) but lost on in-process video (2.10s vs 0.60s); ffmpeg stayed because cross-platform (Win/Mac/Linux) plus format coverage (ogg/opus/wma/avi/mkv/webm) is worth the tradeoff, with AVFoundation recorded as a conditional fallback. External-process discipline: run_tool runs bounded, with timeouts and a bounded stderr tail carried back.

nodes.one_en: Where PDF text layers and page images come from
nodes.def_zh: PDF 处理三件套皆出自 Poppler：pdftotext 抽文本层（提取器版本串 pdftotext@24.08.0 钉死工具版本）、pdftoppm 把页渲染成图（供 Vision OCR 与 mmproj 嵌入）、pdfinfo 报页数（estimate 的折算原料）。文本层的质量取决于 PDF 内嵌的 ToUnicode 映射——阿拉伯丢字病理正发生在这里：文本层缺 lam-连写字形时，复制出来的字残缺，OCR 替换才有了用武之地。长文分页读取（首遍 30 页、之后 50 页步进）也以页为单位。
nodes.def_en: The PDF trio all come from Poppler: pdftotext extracts the text layer (the extractor version string pdftotext@24.08.0 pins the tool), pdftoppm renders pages to images (for Vision OCR and mmproj embedding), and pdfinfo reports page counts (estimate's raw material). Text-layer quality depends on the PDF's embedded ToUnicode maps — the Arabic lostLetters pathology happens right here: when the text layer lacks lam-ligature glyphs, copied text comes out mangled, which is exactly where OCR replacement earns its keep. Long-file pagination (first pass 30 pages, then 50-page steps) is page-anchored too.
nodes.plain_zh: PDF 这个「密封信封」的拆信刀：一刀抽出里面的文字层，一刀把每页拍成图片，还有一刀只数页数。信封里的字帖（ToUnicode 表）缺了帖，抄出来的字就缺胳膊少腿——这时只能把整页拍照重新认字。
nodes.plain_en: The letter opener for PDF 'sealed envelopes': one blade pulls out the text layer, one photographs each page, one just counts pages. If the envelope's character chart (the ToUnicode tables) is missing entries, copied text comes out mangled — and then the only cure is to photograph the page and re-read it.

nodes.one_zh: 8×8 点阵指纹，相似帧快速去重
nodes.one_en: 8×8 bit pattern dedupes near-identical frames
nodes.def_zh: aHash 把帧缩到 8×8 灰度、与平均值比较得 64 个 0/1 位；比较两哈希的「不同位数」（海明距离），≤4 视为同帧。用于视频关键帧去重：每约 3 秒采一帧、至多 1200 帧——静止画面连采 100 帧也只留 1 帧，省下的是每帧 70 token 的嵌入预算。帧提取串（frames=fps1/3,ahash4bit,jpeg1024,max1200）进媒体加工指纹。
nodes.def_en: aHash shrinks a frame to 8×8 grayscale, compares each cell to the average, and yields 64 bits; Hamming distance ≤ 4 counts as the same frame. It dedupes video keyframes: one frame per ~3 seconds, at most 1200 — a static scene sampled 100 times keeps exactly 1, saving 70 tokens of embedding budget per dropped frame. The extraction string (frames=fps1/3,ahash4bit,jpeg1024,max1200) lives in the media preprocessing fingerprint.
nodes.plain_zh: 把每张照片缩成八乘八的黑白小格子，像一张「像素指纹卡」。两张卡只有少数几格不同，就是同一个画面。一分钟的静止画面不用留六十张一样的照片，留一张就够。
nodes.plain_en: Shrink each photo to an 8×8 grid of black/white dots — a tiny dot-pattern ID card. Two cards differing in only a few dots are the same picture. A minute of stillness doesn't need sixty identical photos; one will do.
nodes.example_zh: media.py 里帧提取串写明 frames=fps1/3,ahash4bit,jpeg1024,max1200——每秒三分之一帧、aHash 去重、JPEG 1024、至多 1200 帧。静止画面 100 帧采样后只留 1 帧。

nodes.one_zh: 缩放差一位，向量家族就分裂
nodes.one_en: One bit off in scaling splits the family
nodes.def_zh: 图片进模型前要缩放；本项目把 mtmd/Pillow 风格的双三次缩放（a=−0.5，Catmull-Rom）逐位移植到 goldmine-embed.c，用 22 位定点整数运算规避不同 CPU 浮点实现的末位差异。黄金表测试钉死 helper 与参考实现必须一位不差——缩放差一位 → 向量差一点 → 家族分裂（跨家族比分数，搜索静默变坏）。a=−0.5 是 Pillow 的选择（GGML/PyTorch 用 −0.75）——跟错参考实现就是另一个家族。
nodes.def_en: Images must be resized before entering the model; this project ports the mtmd/Pillow-style bicubic resize (a=−0.5, Catmull-Rom) bit for bit into goldmine-embed.c, using 22-bit fixed-point integer arithmetic to dodge last-digit differences across CPU floating-point implementations. Golden-table tests pin the helper to the reference implementation — one bit off in scaling nudges the vector, and the family splits (cross-family score comparisons silently rot search). a=−0.5 follows Pillow (GGML/PyTorch use −0.75) — follow the wrong reference and you are another family.
nodes.plain_zh: 冲照片的显影工序必须和老师傅的手法分毫不差——差一点点，整卷照片色调就偏了，而且新旧照片摆在一起你会以为是两台相机拍的。整数运算是关键：小数计算在不同芯片上最后一位可能不同，改成整数就钉死了。
nodes.plain_en: The darkroom process must match the old master's technique to the letter — a hair off and the whole roll shifts tint, and mixing old and new prints you'd swear two different cameras shot them. nodes.one_zh: 把一段文字变成 768 个数字
nodes.one_en: Text becomes 768 numbers carrying meaning
nodes.def_zh: 嵌入把任意一段文本映射为一个 768 维浮点向量（embeddinggemma-2，MEAN 池化，归一化）。训练目标是「含义相近 ⇒ 向量夹角小」，于是几何关系成了含义的代理。检索时查询与文档各算一个向量，比较就变成比夹角。这是语义检索领域的通用方法：把「理解」外包给一个预训练模型，工程只负责比较。
nodes.def_en: An embedding maps any text to a 768-dim float vector (embeddinggemma-2, MEAN pooling, normalized). Training pulls semantically close texts toward nearby points, so geometry becomes a proxy for meaning. Search embeds the query and every document once, then compares angles. This is the field's universal move: outsource 'understanding' to a pretrained model; engineering only compares.
nodes.plain_zh: 想象一张巨大的地图，每个意思都有一个坐标——坐标不是两个数，是 768 个数。意思越接近的两段话，坐标离得越近：「猫」和「狗」挨着，「猫」和「资产负债表」隔得很远。电脑不认识字，但它特别擅长算坐标之间的远近。
nodes.plain_en: Picture a giant map where every idea has a coordinate — made not of two numbers but of 768. Texts with similar meaning land close together: 'cat' and 'dog' sit near each other; 'cat' and 'balance sheet' are far apart. Computers don't understand words, but they are superb at measuring distance.
nodes.example_zh: 查询「怎么给长书的分页做索引」能命中讲「长文件续读」的段落——两个短语一个词都不重合，但向量方向接近。亲手验证嵌入没被改坏：GOLDMINE_LIVE=1 python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_reference_vectors.py tests/test_reference_media_vectors.py → 应见 2 passed, 2 skipped（逐位相同）。
nodes.example_en: The query 'how to index pagination for long books' hits a section about 'resuming long files' — zero shared words, nearby vectors. Verify the embedder yourself: GOLDMINE_LIVE=1 python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_reference_vectors.py tests/test_reference_media_vectors.py → expect '2 passed, 2 skipped' (bit-exact).

nodes.one_zh: 只看方向不看长度的夹角
nodes.one_en: Vector angle; length ignored
nodes.def_zh: 两个向量夹角的余弦，等于点积除以模长之积（本项目向量已归一化，点积即余弦）。值域 [0,1]，1 = 方向完全一致。选它而非欧氏距离：文本长短只改变向量长度（幅度），方向才编码含义。这是向量检索的标准比较法——从学术 IR 到工业 ANN 索引通吃。
nodes.def_en: The cosine of the angle between two vectors — dot product over length product (vectors here are normalized, so the dot product is the cosine). Range [0,1]; 1 means identical direction. Chosen over Euclidean distance because text length only changes vector magnitude; direction encodes meaning. This is the standard comparison of vector retrieval — academic IR and industrial ANN indexes alike.
nodes.plain_zh: 两支手电筒从同一点照出去：照向同一个东西，光柱方向几乎重合；照向不同的东西，光柱张开一个角。余弦就是量这个张角——零度得满分 1，九十度得 0。光柱本身多长（文章多长）不重要。
nodes.plain_en: Two flashlights beam from the same spot: aimed at the same object the beams nearly overlap; aimed at different objects they spread apart. Cosine measures that spread — 0 degrees scores 1, 90 degrees scores 0. How long each beam is (how long each text is) doesn't matter.
nodes.example_zh: z 分数手算锚点的起点：26 个向量行，1 个目标行余弦 = 1、其余 25 行 = 0（见 z-score 条目，最终 z = √(26−1) = 5）。goldmine search 加 --why 会把每个命中的余弦与 z 分解打印出来。
nodes.example_en: The anchor for the z-score hand computation: 26 vector rows, one target with cosine 1 and 25 filler rows at 0 (see z-score: the final z = √(26−1) = 5). Run goldmine search with --why to see the cosine and z breakdown printed for every hit.
nodes.analogy_zh: 手电筒光柱的夹角，不是光柱的长短
nodes.analogy_en: The angle between flashlight beams, not their length

deep.rel_zh: 余弦的原始值没有绝对意义，要变成 z
deep.rel_en: A raw cosine means nothing alone; turn it into a z

nodes.one_zh: 这个分数今天有多出众
nodes.one_en: How outstanding this score is today
nodes.def_zh: z = (单个余弦 − 均值) / 标准差。原始余弦没有绝对意义——同一模型对不同查询的分数分布完全不同（A 查询全体 0.8，B 查询全体 0.3），标准化后「出众程度」才可跨查询、跨模态比较。这是统计学最老牌的标准化手法在检索里的应用；准入门槛建在 z 上而非余弦上，正因为 z 随库大小自适应。
nodes.def_en: z = (one cosine − mean) / standard deviation. A raw cosine has no absolute meaning — the same model may score a whole query's results around 0.8 and another's around 0.3 — so standardization is what makes 'how outstanding' comparable across queries and modalities. It is statistics' oldest normalization move applied to retrieval; the admission threshold sits on z, not cosine, precisely because z adapts to corpus size.
nodes.plain_zh: 考试 90 分算高吗？要看全班的平均分和分数波动。平均 85、波动 2 分，你的 90 就非常突出；平均 89、波动 5 分，90 分平平无奇。z 分数就是「你比平均分高出几个波动单位」。
nodes.plain_en: Is 90 on a test a good score? It depends on the class average and the spread. Average 85 with a spread of 2 — your 90 is remarkable. Average 89 with a spread of 5 — your 90 is nothing special. The z-score counts how many 'spread units' you stand above the average.
nodes.example_zh: 手算（测试里钉死）：26 个向量行，1 个目标行余弦 = 1、25 个填充行 = 0。均值 = 1/26，目标偏离 = 25/26，全局 std = 5/26。z = (25/26)/(5/26) = 5 = √(26−1)。通用规律：一行鹤立鸡群时 z ≈ √(n−1)——库越大，同样的领先换来越大的 z。
nodes.example_en: Hand computation (pinned in tests): 26 vector rows, one target with cosine 1, 25 fillers at 0. Mean = 1/26, deviation = 25/26, global std = 5/26. z = (25/26)/(5/26) = 5 = √(26−1). General rule: one standout row gives z ≈ √(n−1) — the bigger the library, the bigger the z for the same lead.

nodes.analogy_en: How many spread-units above the class average

deep.rel_en: Why means split by modality but std doesn't

deep.rel_en: What raw material is being standardized

nodes.one_zh: 文本图片音频各算各的平均分
nodes.one_en: Each modality gets its own mean
nodes.def_zh: z 分数的均值按模态分组计算（文本一组、图片一组、音频一组……），但标准差用全库统一。这是被 DigUp 实测教育出的折中：全按模态分组会让窄组（如 PDF 页）被吹爆——同组一个高分除以极小的组内 std，z 虚高，实测 91→94/105 变差，于是退回全局 std。新增模态组行数 <20 时均值不稳，是维护者要盯的点。多模态检索系统做分数标准化时的通用难题：不同模态的分数基线天然不同。
nodes.def_en: The z-score mean is computed per modality group (text, images, audio, …) while the standard deviation stays global. This compromise was taught by DigUp's measurements: fully per-modality grouping lets narrow groups (like PDF pages) blow up — one high score divided by a tiny within-group std inflates z — and measurably made results worse (91→94 out of 105), so the global std came back. Modality groups under 20 rows have unstable means; maintainers watch for that. A universal puzzle of multimodal retrieval: score baselines differ by nature across modalities.
nodes.plain_zh: 班级平均分怎么算才公平？把体育特长班和普通班混在一起算一个平均，普通班全显得很差。所以平均分分班算，各班跟各班的均值比；但「分数波动的幅度」用全校同一把尺——尺子也分班的话，小班随便一次起伏都被放大成惊天动地。
nodes.plain_en: How should class averages be computed fairly? Mix the athletes' class with the regular class into one average and everyone in the regular class looks bad. So averages are per class — but the 'spread ruler' is school-wide. If the ruler were per class too, any tiny wobble in a small class would look like an earthquake.
nodes.example_zh: 一次搜索里文本行均值 0.42、图片行均值 0.31：同一个余弦 0.40 在图片里「高于平均」，在文本里「低于平均」，z 的符号因此不同。DigUp 全按模态分组的实测代价：91→94/105（变差）。
nodes.example_en: In one search the text rows average 0.42 while image rows average 0.31: the same cosine 0.40 is above average among images but below average among text, flipping the sign of z. DigUp's measured cost of fully per-modality grouping: 91→94 out of 105 — worse.

nodes.one_zh: 语义分加词证分，词证更重
nodes.one_en: Semantic plus heavier word-evidence score
nodes.def_zh: score = 1.0·max(z,0) + 2.0·coverage^1.5（+ 类型命中加 1.0，平坦封顶不叠）。词证权重刻意更重；查询含「字母数字混合带数字」或 ≥4 位纯数字（发票号、工单号）时反转为 (0.5, 4.0)，词法压倒。为什么混合：两条臂各有盲区——纯语义抓不住精确编号，纯词法抓不住同义改写。这是检索领域「hybrid search」的标准命题；融合方式本身也经过实证选择：DigUp 自己的数据里 RRF 融合输给加法融合，故不用 RRF。
nodes.def_en: score = 1.0·max(z,0) + 2.0·coverage^1.5 (+1.0 for a kind match, flat and capped). Word evidence is deliberately heavier; queries containing alphanumeric-with-digit tokens or plain numbers of 4+ digits (invoice or ticket numbers) flip the weights to (0.5, 4.0) so lexical dominates. Why fuse at all: each arm is blind where the other sees — pure semantics misses exact model numbers, pure lexical misses paraphrases. This is the field's standard 'hybrid search' problem; the fusion style itself was chosen empirically — DigUp's own data showed RRF losing to additive fusion, so RRF is out.
nodes.plain_zh: 断案同时听两个证人：一个懂「意思」，一个记性好、认得每个编号。平时更信记性好的那个；问到一串编号时，干脆几乎全听他的。
nodes.plain_en: A case heard by two witnesses: one understands 'meaning', the other has a photographic memory for exact numbers. Normally the memory witness weighs more; ask about a serial number and the verdict is almost entirely theirs.
nodes.example_zh: 常态权重 (w_m, w_c) = (1.0, 2.0)；查询含 TRX50 或 1234567 这类编号时自动翻转为 (0.5, 4.0)。goldmine search TRX50 --why 逐项打印每个命中的 z、coverage 与最终 score 分解。
nodes.example_en: Normal weights (w_m, w_c) = (1.0, 2.0); a query containing 'TRX50' or '1234567' flips them to (0.5, 4.0). goldmine search TRX50 --why prints the z, coverage and final score breakdown for every hit.

nodes.one_zh: 编号类查询词法压倒一切
nodes.one_en: ID-like queries let lexical dominate
nodes.def_zh: 检索领域的老洞察：查询分两种意图——「描述型」（找意思相近的）与「查找型」（找精确编号/代号：TRX50、1234567、CVE-2021-44228）。查找型查询里语义向量几乎无信息量（模型不认识编号），词法精确命中才是唯一可靠证据。落地为权重反转：查询里任一词是「字母数字混合含数字」或 ≥4 位纯数字时，(w_m, w_c) 从 (1.0, 2.0) 翻成 (0.5, 4.0)。这是 query understanding 的最小实现：先判意图，再选打分策略。
nodes.def_en: An old insight of the retrieval field: queries come in two intents — 'descriptive' (find similar meaning) and 'lookup' (find an exact code: TRX50, 1234567, CVE-2021-44228). In lookup queries the semantic vector carries almost no information (models don't know codes); exact lexical hits are the only reliable evidence. Implemented as a weight flip: when any query token is alphanumeric-with-digits or a plain number of 4+ digits, (w_m, w_c) flips from (1.0, 2.0) to (0.5, 4.0). Query understanding in its minimal form: judge intent first, then pick the scoring strategy.
nodes.plain_zh: 问「讲垫片密封的书」和问「编号 TRX50 的主板」是两种问题：前者要懂意思的书，后者要那块板子本身。接待员先听清你问的是哪种，再决定派谁去找——问编号时，记忆型店员一锤定音。
nodes.plain_en: 'Books about gasket sealing' and 'the TRX50 motherboard' are different kinds of asks: the first wants meaning, the second wants that exact board. The clerk listens for which kind you're asking before dispatching — for codes, the memory clerk decides alone.
nodes.example_zh: 判定规则可跟算：'TRX50' 含字母+数字 → 反转；'gasket' 纯字母 → 不反转；'1234567' 七位纯数字 → 反转。用 goldmine search TRX50 --why 对照 goldmine search 垫片 --why，看权重分解的差异。
nodes.example_en: The rule is hand-checkable: 'TRX50' mixes letters and digits → flip; 'gasket' is pure letters → no flip; '1234567' is a seven-digit number → flip. Compare goldmine search TRX50 --why against goldmine search gasket --why and watch the weight breakdown change.

nodes.one_zh: 稀有词值钱，密排短文加分
nodes.one_en: Rare words pay; dense short docs win
nodes.def_zh: BM25 是概率检索框架长出的排名函数，三股力量：IDF（词越稀有越值钱——满篇的「的」不值钱，全书三处的「垫片」值钱）、词频饱和（一个词出现越多越好，但边际收益递减，参数 k1 控制）、长度归一（同样命中密度下短文档占优，参数 b 控制）。它不依赖训练、可解释、快——是倒排索引上几十年不变的默认排名。本项目只用其排名不用其分数：BM25 低 = 好，方向与最终分相反。
nodes.def_en: BM25 is the ranking function that grew out of probabilistic retrieval, three forces at play: IDF (rarer words pay more — 'the' on every page pays nothing, 'gasket' appearing thrice in a corpus pays well), term-frequency saturation (more occurrences help with diminishing returns, tuned by k1), and length normalization (at equal hit density, shorter documents win, tuned by b). No training, interpretable, fast — the default ranking over inverted indexes for decades. This project uses its ranking, never its raw score: BM25 is lower-is-better, opposite to the final score.
nodes.plain_zh: 图书馆的排队规矩：你问的词在馆里越少见，找到的那本越金贵；一本书里这词出现得越密越像真讲这个的（但刷屏不算，边际递减）；同样密度下薄书比厚书更像专讲这个词的。
nodes.plain_en: The library's queueing rules: the rarer your word in the collection, the more precious the book that has it; the denser the word appears in a book, the more it looks like the book is really about it (spamming doesn't count — diminishing returns); at equal density, the thin book beats the thick one for 'about this word'.
nodes.example_zh: 跟算 IDF 的味道：词出现在 1/1000 的文档里比出现在 1/10 的文档里「值钱」约 log(1000/999·10/1) 倍量级。FTS5 内置实现，无需训练数据；--why 里看到的 bm25 排名就是它排的。
nodes.example_en: A taste of hand-computed IDF: a word in 1/1000 documents pays roughly log-multiples more than one in 1/10. FTS5 ships it built-in, no training data; the bm25 rank in --why output is this function's ordering.

nodes.one_zh: N 个位置向量合成一个
nodes.one_en: Many position vectors averaged into one
nodes.def_zh: Transformer 对一段文本的每个位置各输出一个 768 维向量；池化把它们合成单向量，本项目用 MEAN（取平均）。「一段文字一个向量」才好建索引。其他流派：CLS（取特殊首位置的向量）、LAST（取末位置）。池化方式是指纹的规范字段之一——换 MEAN/CLS/LAST 等于换向量家族，旧库会被指纹门拒绝。这是所有句向量模型的共同工序，各家方言不同。
nodes.def_en: A transformer emits one 768-dim vector per token position; pooling merges them into a single vector — MEAN (average) here. One vector per text is what makes indexing possible. Other schools: CLS (the special first position's vector) and LAST (the final position's). The pooling mode is a canonical fingerprint field — switching MEAN/CLS/LAST switches vector families, and the fingerprint gate refuses the old library. A shared step of every sentence-embedding model; each speaks its own dialect.
nodes.plain_zh: 一篇文章每个段落各打一次分，但索引里一格只能放一个分数——于是取平均。怎么合并是「方言」的一部分：换个合并规矩，所有向量全变了味，必须全部重算。
nodes.plain_en: Every paragraph of an essay gets its own score, but the index has room for only one — so take the average. How you merge is part of the dialect: change the merging rule and every vector changes flavor; everything must be recomputed.
nodes.example_zh: embeddinggemma-2 + MEAN 池化写进指纹八字段之一（pooling 字段，llama-server --pooling mean）。把 MEAN 改成 CLS 会改变每个存量向量的取值 ⇒ 指纹变 ⇒ search 拒绝服务 exit 3，直到重建索引。
nodes.example_en: embeddinggemma-2 + MEAN pooling is one of the fingerprint's eight canonical fields ('pooling', llama-server --pooling mean). Changing MEAN to CLS changes every stored vector ⇒ the fingerprint changes ⇒ search refuses with exit 3 until the index is rebuilt.

nodes.one_zh: 一切内容搬进同一个向量空间
nodes.one_en: Everything moved into one vector space
nodes.def_zh: 多模态表示学习的核心方法：训练一个投影头，把图片/音频编码器的输出映射进文本嵌入的同一空间，使「一张猫的照片」与「猫」这个词可直接比夹角。与之相对的是双塔分离空间（各自编码、靠对比损失对齐）或跨空间检索映射。本项目的实例是 mmproj：图片/音频向量与文本向量同为 768 维、同受一套 z 与准入规则管辖——多模态检索才不需要「每模态一套算法」。
nodes.def_en: The core method of multimodal representation learning: train a projection head mapping image/audio encoder outputs into the same space as text embeddings, so 'a photo of a cat' angles directly against the word 'cat'. Contrasts: two-tower separate spaces (each encoded, aligned by contrastive loss) or cross-space retrieval mappings. This project's instance is mmproj: image/audio vectors are 768-dim like text vectors and live under the same z and admission rules — multimodal retrieval without 'one algorithm per modality'.
nodes.plain_zh: 让所有材料说同一种坐标语言：文字、图片、声音都登记在同一张巨幅地图上。只有这样，「用文字问、拿图片答」才可能——问的人和答的人在同一张地图上找对方。
nodes.plain_en: Make all materials speak one coordinate language: text, images, sound all registered on the same giant map. Only then can 'ask in words, answer in pictures' work — asker and answerer find each other on the same map.
nodes.example_zh: goldmine search 'a cat on a keyboard' 能命中猫趴键盘的照片：查询文字向量与照片向量在同一 768 维空间里夹角很小。验证：GOLDMINE_LIVE=1 python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_reference_media_vectors.py（媒体向量与文本向量同一合同）。
nodes.example_en: goldmine search 'a cat on a keyboard' hits the photo of a cat on a keyboard: the query's text vector and the photo's vector sit at a small angle in the same 768-dim space. Verify: GOLDMINE_LIVE=1 python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_reference_media_vectors.py (media and text vectors under one contract).

nodes.one_zh: 少几位精度，换一半空间几倍速
nodes.one_en: Fewer bits, half the space, more speed
nodes.def_zh: 把模型权重从浮点压到低位整数的方法族：Q8_0（8 位对称分组）、Q5_0、Q4 等。原理：权重数值分布集中，低位整数十缩放因子足够表达；组内共享缩放因子摊薄误差。收益是空间减半以上、推理快数倍；代价是精度损失随位宽下降而可测上升——所以有「Q8_0 够好、Q4 危险、F16 反而溢出」这种实测边界。同一思想也用在存储侧（fp16 向量）与像素侧（定点缩放）：本质都是「用有限格点近似连续值，并实测钉住边界」。
nodes.def_en: The family of methods packing model weights from floats into low-bit integers: Q8_0 (8-bit symmetric blocks), Q5_0, Q4, etc. The principle: weight values cluster, so low-bit integers times scale factors suffice; per-block shared scales spread out error. Gains: half the space or better, several times the speed; cost: accuracy loss becomes measurable as bit width drops — hence the measured boundaries 'Q8_0 fine, Q4 risky, F16 ironically overflows'. The same idea appears storage-side (fp16 vectors) and pixel-side (fixed-point resize): all fundamentally 'approximate continuous values with finite grids, and pin the boundary by measurement'.
nodes.plain_zh: 行李装箱法：衣服真空压缩（Q8）省一半空间；压得太狠（Q4）西装就皱得不能穿了。奇怪的是有个行李箱（F16）看着更高级，装这个牌子的衣服反而会撑破——实测过，不猜。
nodes.plain_en: Luggage packing: vacuum-compress the clothes (Q8) and save half the space; compress too hard (Q4) and the suit arrives unwearable. Oddly, one fancier suitcase (F16) actually bursts with this brand of clothes — measured, not guessed.
nodes.example_zh: 本项目的三处量化跟算：权重 Q8_0（1.5GB→800MB）、whisper Q5_0、向量存储 fp16（1536 字节/条）。每处都有一条实测边界（F16 禁令/Q4 警戒/排序无影响）写进文档。
nodes.example_en: Three quantizations to trace here: weights Q8_0 (1.5GB→800MB), whisper Q5_0, and fp16 vector storage (1536 bytes each). Each has a measured boundary on record (the F16 ban / the Q4 warning / ordering unaffected).

nodes.one_zh: 搜索质量的三把尺子
nodes.one_en: Three rulers for search quality
nodes.def_zh: s@5 = 前 5 条里有没有正确答案（0/1）；MRR = 正确答案排名的倒数（第 1 名 1.0、第 3 名约 0.33）；nDCG@10 = 前 10 条带位置折扣的综合分。三者互补：s@5 看「捞没捞到」，MRR 看「排多前」，nDCG 看「整个榜单的质量分布」。另有 zero-hit honesty 尺量噪音查询是否正确返回零。选尺即选价值观：本项目的门用 s@5/MRR 主尺 + 诚实度辅尺。
nodes.def_en: s@5 = whether the top 5 contain a correct answer (0/1); MRR = the reciprocal of the correct answer's rank (rank 1 → 1.0, rank 3 → 0.33); nDCG@10 = a position-discounted composite over the top 10. They complement: s@5 asks 'did we catch it', MRR asks 'how high', nDCG asks 'how well ordered overall'. A fourth ruler, zero-hit honesty, checks that noise queries correctly return nothing. Choosing rulers is choosing values: this project's gate uses s@5/MRR as primary plus honesty as auxiliary.
nodes.plain_zh: 找东西的三种打分法：一、前五个结果里有没有对的（及格/不及格）；二、对的排第几（越靠前越好）；三、整个榜单排得像不像话（好东西越靠前越好）。
nodes.plain_en: Three ways to grade a search: one, was anything correct in the first five (pass/fail); two, where did the right one rank (higher is better); three, does the whole list make sense (good stuff near the top).
nodes.example_zh: z_gate 2.0→3.0 的 A/B 用这些尺记录：s@5 0.747→0.781、MRR 0.646→0.665（n=146 真模型评测）。自己跑回归门：python3 scripts/eval_real.py --suite legacy --backend llama --gate → 结尾 gate: green 且各指标 delta 全 +0.0000。
nodes.example_en: The z_gate 2.0→3.0 A/B was recorded with these rulers: s@5 0.747→0.781, MRR 0.646→0.665 (n=146, real-model eval). Run the gate yourself: python3 scripts/eval_real.py --suite legacy --backend llama --gate → ends with 'gate: green' and every metric delta at +0.0000.

nodes.one_zh: 分清真改进还是运气
nodes.one_en: Telling real improvement from luck
nodes.def_zh: 判断「新旧分数之差是真改进还是噪声」的统计检验。McNemar 只看一增一失的题（两边都对的题不提供信息）；成对 bootstrap 反复重抽样本算差的置信区间。结论形如「p=1.0 / CI 含 0」= 没证据说是真变化。数学根据：128 题的样本里一题摆动就是 0.8%——不检验就会把噪声当成果，这是「不做质量重试」纪律的来源。
nodes.def_en: Statistical tests for 'is this score difference real or noise'. McNemar looks only at discordant pairs (questions one side got and the other missed — both-correct items carry no information); paired bootstrap resamples to build a confidence interval for the difference. A verdict like 'p=1.0 / CI contains 0' means no evidence of real change. The math behind it: with 128 questions, one flipped question is 0.8% — without testing, noise gets celebrated as progress. This is where the 'no quality retries' discipline comes from.
nodes.plain_zh: 两个学生考试差 2 分，能说谁更厉害吗？先只看「甲对乙错」和「甲错乙对」的题——两人都对的题不算数。再看班里的正常波动：分差小于波动幅度，就老老实实说「分不出高下」。
nodes.plain_en: Two students differ by 2 points — does that prove who is better? First count only the questions one got right and the other missed; questions both solved prove nothing. Then weigh the class's normal wobble: a gap smaller than the wobble means an honest 'too close to call'.
nodes.example_zh: digup-plan-001 的 A/B 零改善即按预注册判负回滚，而不是「再试试别的参数」。128 题套件上任何 ±0.8% 的摆动都要先过统计检验再谈采纳。
nodes.example_en: digup-plan-001's A/B showing zero improvement was rolled back per preregistration — not 'let's try other knobs'. On the 128-question suite, any ±0.8% wobble passes a statistical test before anyone talks about adopting it.

nodes.one_zh: 封存一半题，只在验收时打开
nodes.one_en: Half the questions sealed until acceptance
nodes.def_zh: 题库分两半：train 用来调参，holdout 封存只在最后验收打开。只用 train 调出的「改进」可能只是背题（过拟合）；holdout 是防背题的考卷。这是机器学习的通用方法（train/validation/test 划分）在检索评测里的最小实现。本项目 holdout 密封（有 freeze 测试守卫），任何 reports 外的 holdout 路径不碰；校准纪律要求 train 与 holdout 一致才算数。
nodes.def_en: The question bank splits in half: train for tuning, holdout sealed until final acceptance. An 'improvement' tuned only on train may just be memorization (overfitting); holdout is the anti-memorization exam. It is machine learning's universal split (train/validation/test) in its minimal retrieval-eval form. This project's holdout is sealed (guarded by freeze tests), no path outside reports touches it, and calibration requires train and holdout to agree before anything counts.
nodes.plain_zh: 复习题和考试卷分开印。天天对着考试卷练，成绩再高也是背题。平时只许看复习题，考试卷锁在柜子里，最后真刀真枪才算数。
nodes.plain_en: Print practice exams and the final exam separately. Drill on the final itself and any high score is memorization. Practice papers only, the final locked in a cabinet, and the real thing counts once.
nodes.example_zh: z_gate=3.0 的采纳依据之一是「train 和 holdout 一致」；3.5 虽在 train 更好（0.822）但只扫了一次，不敢信。守卫测试：python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_joint_holdout.py tests/test_joint_holdout_freeze.py。
nodes.example_en: Adopting z_gate=3.0 leaned on 'train and holdout agree'; 3.5 looked better on train (0.822) after a single scan and was not trusted. Guard tests: python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_joint_holdout.py tests/test_joint_holdout_freeze.py.

nodes.one_zh: 每次重跑都与冻结基线对表
nodes.one_en: Every rerun checked against frozen baseline
nodes.def_zh: 回归门 = CI 式的重跑与冻结基线对表、超阈值即红的机制。思想内核：改动的影响不由作者声称，而由「重跑同一套题、对比同一把尺」暴露。配套纪律：基线必须冻结（否则没有稳定的比较锚）；语料或身份漂移要响亮作废基线（corpus_version + corpus_sha），而不是静默换分母；基线重生的唯一通道是审计门。这是从 CI 回归测试到评测门共用的工程方法。
nodes.def_en: A regression gate is the CI-style mechanism of rerunning against a frozen baseline and going red past a threshold. The core idea: a change's impact is not claimed by its author but exposed by 'rerun the same questions, compare the same rulers'. Companion disciplines: baselines must be frozen (else no stable anchor); corpus or identity drift must void the baseline loudly (corpus_version + corpus_sha), never silently swap the denominator; the audit gate is the only path to rebirth. The engineering method shared by CI regression tests and eval gates alike.
nodes.plain_zh: 体测成绩贴在墙上不许改：每次训练完重新测一遍，跟墙上的数字比——退步了墙上就亮红字。哪天换了体测项目（语料变了），墙上旧成绩立即作废重贴，绝不拿「跳绳时代的成绩」跟「跑步时代」比。
nodes.plain_en: Fitness scores are posted on the wall, uneditable: after each training block, retest and compare against the wall — regressions glow red. The day the test events change (the corpus moved), the old wall is voided and reposted; you never compare rope-jump-era scores against running-era scores.
nodes.example_zh: python3 scripts/eval_real.py --suite legacy --backend llama --gate：与冻结基线逐指标对比，结尾 gate: green 或红。双 gate（legacy 109 题 + 全媒体套件）都过才算不回归。
nodes.example_en: python3 scripts/eval_real.py --suite legacy --backend llama --gate: metric-by-metric comparison against the frozen baseline, ending 'gate: green' or red. Both gates (legacy 109 + the all-media suite) must pass for a no-regression claim.
